Chapter 617: Chapter 39 Martial Tao Rankings (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 617: Chapter 39 Martial Tao Rankings (Please Subscribe)_2

“Some Tier 11 Evolution Paths are ranked after the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?” Lin Yuan glanced at it and marveled inwardly.

He had still underestimated the true potential of the current Martial Path Evolutionary Path. In terms of ranking, it was incredible that the Ninth Stage Martial Tao supressed an Eleventh Tier Evolution Path.

That was an Eleventh Tier Evolution Path, a path that hoped to steadily cultivate to Tier 11, even if its potential to advance was zero. But it had already reached the endpoint of many Evolution Paths.

“It seems that in the judgment of the three goddesses, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has the potential to transform into a Supreme Evolution Path,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Only this could explain the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

The Tier 11 Evolution Paths presently controlled by Human Civilization were many whose potentials had been exhausted, with no hope of touching the Supreme Evolution Path. This was the only possible reason for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path to exceed the others.

...

“Supreme Evolution Path…” Lin Yuan’s heart raced.

This was the desire of countless lives. Merely looking back at several decades ago, when a corpse of a Supreme Being drifted in from the space cracks of a large alien battlefield outside, it caused many Supreme Beings of the Main Universe to fight fiercely.

This alone showed how precious the Supreme Evolution Path was.

This was merely speculation that the deceased Supreme Being might have contained a Supreme Evolution Path, a mere possibility that led the Insect Race to take a dangerous risk.

“Human Civilization Evolution Rankings…” Lin Yuan continued looking at the last leaderboard.

The Human Civilization Evolution Rankings, the most authoritative list, includes the hundred strongest Evolution Paths ever in Human Civilization, including those nine Supreme Evolution Paths.

“Not entered into the top hundred…” Lin Yuan wasn’t surprised at all.

It could be said that the Evolution Paths on the Human Civilization Evolution Rankings all possess great potential, even with hopes of transforming into Supreme Evolution Paths, which are Eleventh Tier EVolution Paths.

Even if the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has infinite potential, it is ultimately just a Ninth Rank Evolution Path. It would be strange if it made it onto the Human Civilization Evolution Rankings.

…

After uploading the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and obtaining an astronomical amount of Merit Points, Lin Yuan then took out the Mysterious Gourd.

“Let’s focus on restoring the nearly two-hundred-billion-li radius Inner World,” Lin Yuan planned inwardly.

Before the ninth transit, Lin Yuan’s absorption of the liquid in the Mysterious Gourd had only reached the fifth drop, and his Inner World was only a little over 1.6 billion li in size.

Now, the Inner World was nearing two hundred billion li in radius.

Although it seemed like only thirty million li in radius had been added on the surface,

when combining over two billion Spatial Layers, one could realize the terrifying increase.

Each layer of the Inner World, theoretically, is no smaller than the main space. The added thirty million li in radius, multiplied by over two billion… Even though the power contained in each individual Spatial Layer is far less than that of the main space, the sheer quantity is overwhelming.

“The Inner Worlds of the two Divine Spirits… I’ll wait for the Taiyang Divine Spirit to return before worrying about that,” Lin Yuan was determined to prioritize the full recovery of his True Body first.

As for the Taiyang Divine Spirit… whether or not the Taiyang Divine Spirit fully recovers, the impact isn’t significant, especially since only Ninth Rankers enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Given the known limit of Ninth Rank combat power does not exceed ten thousand, having one hundred million combat power or eighty million on the Taiyang Divine Spirit makes no noticeable difference.

…

Annan Star Alliance Virtual World, Central Plaza Area.

Evolver after evolver and high-ranking citizens continuously appeared, looking towards the towering Evolution Rankings board, and the top-ranked Martial Path Evolutionary Path, their expressions invariably revealed shock.

Decades ago, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path first appeared on the Annan Evolution Rankings and topped the rankings as soon as it appeared, dropping many strong jaws.

Other Evolution Paths, even if their rankings rose, did so painstakingly, one or two places at a time.

But the Martial Path Evolutionary Path did well, jumping a hundred places to top the Annan Evolution Rankings straight away.

Such an incredible rise in rankings has never occurred since the establishment of the Annan Star Alliance and was completely irrational.

“I heard that this Martial Path Evolutionary Path originated from the Chikun Star Domain. It also topped the Chikun Evolution Rankings at an extremely frightening pace…”

“Compare Chikun Star Domain to our Annan Star Alliance? However, this Martial Path Evolutionary Path is indeed terrifying; none of our many Ninth Rank Evolution Paths from Annan Star Alliance could suppress it?”

“Hehehe, while you all are still doubting the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, I’ve already started training the younger generation. With the potential displayed by the Martial Path Evolutionary Path now, who knows, it might even advance to a Ninth Rank Evolutionary Path in the future.”

…

One by one, Evolvers and high-ranking citizens spoke, and naturally, the core of their disputes was still on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

After all, this evolutionary path was too dazzling; compared to it, other evolutionary paths from the same period were utterly dim.

Fortunately, the creator of this evolutionary path was a mysterious evolutionary scholar of human civilization, which was acceptable.

After all, an evolutionary scholar was a representation of the pinnacle of human civilization, and each evolutionary scholar represented its depth.

The minimum requirement for an evolutionary scholar was to be an Eighth Rank Evolver.

Many evolutionary scholars’ strength reached the Tenth or Eleventh Rank.

“When will this mysterious evolutionary scholar update the Ninth Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?” a high-ranking citizen asked expectantly.

“I think it’s difficult.”

“Many people thought it was difficult before the update of the Sixth Rank Chapter, Seventh Rank Chapter, and Eighth Rank Chapter.”

“It’s different, how could the Ninth Rank Chapter be the same as the previous ones?”

…

Many Evolvers and high-ranking citizens had some disagreements.

“Foolish, still daring to question the update speed of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?” a thin man sat in the corner of the Central Plaza Area.

He came from the Chikun Star Domain and had personally witnessed the rise of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, knowing that this evolutionary path couldn’t be speculated by common sense.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path … alas, my foundation is already set, and the cost of switching to training in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would be too great,” the thin man regretted.

Immediately, he opened the detailed overview of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, wishing to take another look at the content of the Seventh Rank Chapter and Eighth Rank Chapter.

Although he had not practiced the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he had purchased all the chapters from First Rank to Eighth Rank.

Even if he couldn’t make the Martial Path Evolutionary Path his core evolutionary path, using it as a secondary practice was no problem.

“Huh?”

The thin man opened the detailed information of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and casually refreshed it, his expression suddenly froze.

For he saw three new words added after the original Eighth Rank Chapter.

Ninth Rank Chapter.

“Has the Martial Path Evolutionary Path been updated with the Ninth Rank Chapter?”

The thin man was greatly shocked. He looked around; most people were still disputing, while a few Evolvers had slightly changed expressions, probably noticing the updated Ninth Rank Chapter.

“Ninth Rank Evolutionary Path,” the thin man thought deeply. After the update to the Ninth Rank Chapter, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would officially enter the ranks of the Ninth Rank Evolutionary Path.

“Annan Evolution Rankings still first …” the thin man then looked towards the distant towering Evolution Rankings and saw that the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was still hanging at the top.

When the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was at Eighth Rank, it had already topped the Annan Evolution Rankings; now, with the update to the Ninth Rank Chapter, the Annan Evolution Rankings could not show the potential increase of the updated Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Southern Star Region Evolution Rankings …” the thin man opened the Southern Star Region Evolution Rankings with mixed feelings.

“Fifty-third place?” the thin man fell silent; the Southern Star Region included countless areas like the Annan Star Alliance, and their rankings included evolutionary paths where the lowest was Tenth Rank. Breaking into the top ninety was basically Eleventh Rank evolutionary paths.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path had suddenly surged to the fifty-third place?

This this this … even though the thin man highly regarded the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he now began to wonder if there was a mistake in the ranking.

Meanwhile,

as time passed,

other neighboring Evolvers and high-ranking citizens gradually discovered the update of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and its final ranking.
